raw_context: Live-selling call to action: 'Pa-mine na lang po!' — asking viewers to comment 'mine' to claim an item. From Filipino Facebook/TikTok live selling streams. Documented by GMA Network, SBS Filipino, PhilArchive.
'Shot puno' is a Filipino slang used in drinking sessions that means 'bottoms up.' K-pop idol BamBam of GOT7 tweeted an 'after shot puno' photo that went viral. Urban Dictionary entry confirmed.

TikTok PH trend in 2024-2025: Filipinos romanticizing meeting someone naturally without dating apps. 'Nagkita kayo sa café dahil pareho kayong mahilig sa kape, hindi dahil sa dating app — iyan ang organic encounter.' (Threads/@dnssjvr, 2025). Spot.ph 2025 words list, 8list.ph article.
Phrase used when someone is overdoing something. 'Over naman sa ask!' 'Over naman sa story!' Recognized by Komisyon ng Wikang Filipino as new Filipino language form. TikTok PH viral 2025.

Gen Z respelling of 'po' (formal respectful particle). Used in text and social media for a cuter feel. 'Salamat pi!' Documented by ling-app.com (January 2025): 'Pi is a Gen-Z Tagalog slang that uses a different spelling for the formal word po.'
Variant spelling of 'char' (just kidding). Part of Gen Z creative respelling trend. Documented by ling-app.com (2025) alongside 'kimmy' for 'keme' and 'pi' for 'po'.

Filipino political slang in 2025: children of politicians who flaunted lavish lifestyles linked to ₱118B flood control corruption scandal. 'Nagdelete na ng socials ang mga nepo babies.' UNTV News, BusinessWorld, Inquirer, Tribune coverage 2025.
Variant spelling of 'keme' (vague filler: something/whatever/et cetera). Part of Gen Z creative respelling trend. Documented by ling-app.com (2025) alongside 'pi' and 'chour'.
